claims.text: NASA ordered Boeing’s Starliner to return uncrewed because the spacecraft experienced five reaction-control system (RCS) thruster anomalies during its docking approach, and these issues could not be guaranteed safe for the deorbit burn [Source: ev-1].
The decision was made on 2024-08-24 after NASA determined that the thrusters could not be ground-tested in their flight condition to verify safety [Source: ev-1].

This decision had significant implications for the program:
*   **Crew Duration:** Astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams remained aboard the International Space Station until returning via a Crew-9 Dragon on 2025-03-18, spending roughly 9.5 months aloft compared to the planned ~8 days [Source: ev-1].
